chapter: Rapid Restitution to the Raging Fish...
act_title: Rapid Restitution to the Raging Fish...

quests.title: Rapid Restitution to the Raging Fish...

dialogue.t: I'm convinced that our search for a cure is entering its final stages.
But besides finding a few more aquatic patients to complete the list, I have another, more particular request...
I need you to locate some key underwater mechanisms in the affected waters and retrieve the data recorded by their sensors...

dialogue.sit: Then analyze the data to uncover any relevant patterns...?
So we can prevent similar incidents in the future?

dialogue.t: We should also talk to the boat owners and divers to make sure they've learned their lessons!
That's right, not to mention the fishermen and the tourists... Anyone who takes a boat out on the surface, and those who dive beneath it...
Everyone who interacts with our waters needs to be mindful. They can't just dump things in the sea and go around destroying marine habitats.
Otherwise, some very aggressive fish might come along and capsize their boats!

quests.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us…
